strengths: Coherent neon look in cyan and teal: bloom on the arena walls, a glowing snake head and a pink food item
Clean, consistent HUD (score, best, level) and matching title and game-over panels, including a 'NEW BEST!' message
Eating spawns a small burst of particles, and the snake's tail fades from the head along the body
Stable in the automated run: 0 page errors, 22 foods eaten in 40 s, 12/13 checks passed, and it fits a portrait phone screen
weaknesses: The snake and food are tiny compared with the board, so the scene looks empty and the game is hard to read, especially on a phone
The walls' glow is too strong and outshines everything that matters to play; the palette is almost one color
Very basic 3D: flat square segments seen from almost straight above, a fixed camera, no visible shadows and no modeled shapes or scenery
Generic Tron-style neon theme with no surprising ideas; the eating effect is weak and barely shows
Fails 'Enter starts a new game at once' after game over
oneLine: A tidy, stable neon snake with good bloom and a cohesive HUD, but its tiny pieces, empty board and flat almost top-down 3D make it look like a polished tech demo more than a finished indie game.
